細.meaning: A mouse in a tutu tiptoes across a single <part>thread</part> strung high over a <part>rice field</part>, twirling a parasol the size of a petal. Each step is light as a sigh, and the thread doesn't even wobble. She is so <kanji>dainty</kanji>.
細.on: Halfway across, she sips one drop of apple <sound>ci</sound>der from a thimble.
細.kun: Then she naps on a <sound>co</sound>t of moss while her <sound>ma</sound>ma checks every tiny, detailed stitch of her tutu.

太.meaning: A <part>large</part> man eats one more <part>dot</part> of chocolate, just one, and snap! His belt gives way. He pats his round tummy happily and asks for seconds anyway. He's gone a bit <kanji>plump</kanji>.
太.on: He loosens his <sound>tie</sound> too and orders the dessert menu.
太.kun: He flops onto a <sound>fu</sound>ton and balances a cake on <sound>to</sound>p of his thick belly.

読.meaning: A market trader wants to <part>sell</part> his books, but nobody stops. So he opens one and turns every page into <part>speech</part>, voices and all. A crowd gathers, gasping at the plot. He doesn't just sell stories; he loves to <kanji>read</kanji>.
読.on: He moves his stall down to the <sound>dock</sound>, so the sailors can listen too.
読.kun: He reads aloud so long that his pot of <sound>yo</sound>gurt goes warm in the sun.

星.meaning: A tiny <part>sun</part> has sprouted from a seed in your garden, full of <part>life</part>, growing leaves and humming. At night you pick it and toss it up into the sky, where it twinkles forever. You've planted a <kanji>star</kanji>.
星.on: You keep the next seed locked away in a steel <sound>sa</sound>fe, just in case.
星.kun: It glows so <sound>ho</sound>t you have to catch it on a <sound>shi</sound>eld.

黒.meaning: The whole <part>farm</part> holds a sausage barbecue over a mountain of <part>hot coals</part>, but the farmer falls asleep. When he wakes up, the sausages, the cows, the fence and his own beard are covered in soot. Everything is <kanji>black</kanji>.
黒.on: A white <sound>cock</sound>atoo lands on the grill and flies off a sooty black one.
黒.kun: A <sound>cu</sound>ckoo sits on a <sound>ro</sound>ck nearby, black from beak to tail.

負.meaning: At the beach, a <part>shellfish</part> challenges you to a throwing contest. You fling your <part>boomerang</part> with all your might; it loops round and bonks you on the head. The shellfish wins by a mile. Total <kanji>defeat</kanji>.
負.on: You limp home and hide under your <sound>fu</sound>ton for the rest of the day.
負.kun: '<sound>Ma</sound>, I lost to a shellfish!' you wail from under the covers.

殺.meaning: A <part>maiden</part> finds a poison vine strangling her favourite <part>tree</part>. She grabs her <part>scissors</part> and snips through every stem until it shrivels and drops. That vine won't grow back: she's gone in for the <kanji>kill</kanji>.
殺.on: Then she rewards the tree with a juicy <sound>sats</sound>uma tied to its lowest branch.
殺.kun: She drags the dead vine off on a <sound>co</sound>t and buries it under a <sound>ro</sound>ck.

技.meaning: A sailor balances a heavy <part>anchor</part> on the tip of a thin <part>branch</part>, then spins it like a plate on a stick, and the twig doesn't even bend. The crowd on the pier roars. That takes real <kanji>skill</kanji>.
技.on: For an encore he does the same trick with a huge iron <sound>gea</sound>r.
技.kun: '<sound>Wah</sound>!' gasp the shoppers in the ba<sound>za</sound>ar behind the pier.
